prompts.text: Two billiard balls on a green felt table: one ball rolls across the table and strikes a stationary ball of equal size, transferring motion in a realistic collision. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
A cue ball breaks a triangular rack of billiard balls on a pool table, scattering the balls realistically. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.

Water is poured from a glass bottle into a drinking glass on a table: the stream falls realistically, the water level in the glass rises, and a little water splashes. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
A stone is dropped into a still pond: it sinks, the water surface ripples outward in concentric circles, and the ripples gradually die down. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
Wooden blocks of different sizes are stacked one on top of another on a table into a stable tower; the tower stays standing without falling or floating. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
A truck drives across a bridge: the bridge stays intact and the truck does not sink or fall through. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
A person tosses a tennis ball up into the air and catches it with one hand as it falls back down. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
A row of dominoes stands on a table; the first domino is pushed over and the rest fall one after another in a chain reaction. Realistic physics, fixed camera, no text.
